recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core follow-up is needed unless a future generated primitive profile again emits XML Schema names as ElementDefinition.type.code values.
issue_request: FHIR-8540 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core StructureDefinition issue from DSTU1. It reported that primitive datatype profiles such as instant.value carried ElementDefinition.type.code values like xs:dateTime, violating the datatype binding, and the resolution agreed that schema types should not be listed there.
initial_application: The request was applied by svn revision 6172, represented in git as a98d42388273e9fb79a6a9d93ab717b185741b4e (#8540 - remove schema types from profiles), which removed generator assignments that populated primitive value type codes from XML Schema type names.
additional_context: Current narrative still mentions xs:* values as XML representation details for primitives, but those are serialization-domain descriptions rather than ElementDefinition.type.code values. Checked release profile bundles use no xs:* primitive value type codes, and R4B/R5 profile entries use FHIRPath system type codes plus structuredefinition-fhir-type extensions for the FHIR primitive names.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the invalid schema-code profile representation requested by FHIR-8540 is already absent from current in-scope source and checked generated profile surfaces.
